issues.claim: Require attack-free training/calibration, authorised access, Yocto on-device execution within agreed budgets, and no measurable forwarding-latency increase under agreed representative loads.

sources.quote: A few of them have been running their networks for twenty years with no security monitoring at all, so if they were compromised they would not know.
We have plenty of normal traffic — we have collected several terabytes of captures from consenting clients over the past three years — but we have nothing labelled as malicious.

issues.explanation: Requiring attack-free training and calibration makes the pilot depend on a cleanliness guarantee the company cannot provide, contradicting the proposal's own treatment of the archives as unlabelled. Require no attack-labelled training or calibration instead, and explicitly assess sensitivity to possible contamination.
